he.text: אַל־תָּבוֹא בְמִשְׁפָּט עִמָּנוּ כִּי לֹא־יִצְדַּק לְפָנֶיךָ כָל־חָי׃ צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶךָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶיךָ׃ מִלְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטֵנוּ יֵצֵא עֵינֶיךָ תֶחֱזֶינָה מֵישָׁרִים׃ וְהוּא־יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק יָדִין לְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃ רַחֲמֶיךָ רַבִּים יי כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חַיֵּינוּ׃ הִנָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵט הָאָרֶץ הָשֵׁב גְּמוּל עַל־גֵּאִים׃ כִּי־יי שֹׁפְטֵנוּ יי מְחֹקְקֵנוּ יי מַלְכֵּנוּ הוּא יוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ׃ חָלִלָה לְּךָ מֵעֲשֹׂת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְהָמִית צַדִּיק עִם־רָשָׁע

en.text: Enter not into judgment with us: for in thy presence no man living can be justified. Righteousness and justice are the basis of thy throne; mercy and truth precede thy presence. Let our sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold our rectitude. And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he will minister justice to the people with rectitude. Thy tender mercies are abundant, O Lord! revive us according to thy judgment. Exalt thyself, O thou judge of the earth, render a reward to the proud. For the Lord is our Judge; the Lord is our Lawgiver; the Lord is our King! he will save us! Far be that from thee to do after this
Heb., the things which are right.

he.text: וְהָיָה כַצַּדִּיק כָּרָשָׁע חָלִלָה לָּךְ הֲשֹׁפֵט כָּל־הָאָרֶץ לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט׃

en.text: manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked, far be that from thee. “Shall not the judge of all the earth do justice?”
